name: Delpho USDV
oneLiner: HyperEVM CDP dollar backed by USDC, USDT0, kHYPE, and WHYPE collateral deployed into HyperCore funding-rate hedging vaults.
collateral: Overcollateralized USDC, USDT0, kHYPE, and WHYPE collateral vaults plus a USDC peg stability module; vault collateral is deployed into HyperCore delta-neutral and portfolio-margin strategies via CoreWriter.
pegMechanism: Borrowers mint USDV at 0% interest against stablecoin collateral (up to 95% LTV, 97% liquidation threshold) or HYPE and kHYPE collateral (up to 65% LTV, 80% liquidation threshold). Holders can swap USDC at 25 bps via the PSM while idle buffer remains, or queue direct market redemptions settled on a 24-hour epoch cycle (0.20% fee for stablecoins, 0.50% for HYPE).

proofOfReserves.provider: On-chain HyperEVM vault and PSM accounting; not independent financial assurance

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: USDV is minted as overcollateralized borrower debt across isolated stablecoin (95% max LTV) and HYPE/kHYPE (65% max LTV) CDP markets, alongside a USDC peg stability module. Protocol revenue from HyperCore funding and portfolio-margin strategies flows to optional sUSDV stakers rather than rebasing USDV itself. The cdp archetype matches the verified DelphoVault and DelphoStableManager architecture.
